name: minecraft-seed-tools
description: Chunkbase-style Minecraft Seed Map and Seed Finder (Java + Bedrock) with a shared WASM/native generation engine

scripts.gen:golden: cmake -S . -B build/native >/dev/null && cmake --build build/native --target golden_dump >/dev/null && ./build/native/golden_dump tests/golden/worlds.bin
scripts.test:golden-regen: mkdir -p /tmp/opencode && cmake -S . -B build/native >/dev/null && cmake --build build/native --target golden_dump >/dev/null && ./build/native/golden_dump /tmp/opencode/worlds.regen.bin >/dev/null && cmp tests/golden/worlds.bin /tmp/opencode/worlds.regen.bin && echo 'golden regen: byte-identical'
scripts.test: npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:wasm-pack && npm run test:finder && npm run test:structures && npm run test:versions && npm run test:golden && npm run test:golden-regen && npm run test:browser && npm run test:interface && npm run test:android && npm run test:android-device && npm run build:aar && npm run test:swift && npm run test:csharp && npm run test:python
